title: Run-level wall-clock limit — fix test failures and wiring gaps
goal: Correct all test failures, lint violations, and wiring gaps found after the first build pass so that npm test and npm run lint both pass and every acceptance criterion is verifiably met.

steps.description: Fix tests/unit/run-limit-precedence-test.sh: correct the bash syntax error at line 173 where an env-var assignment cannot prefix a subshell literal (use a wrapper or move the assignment inside the subshell); fix the lint-test-errexit violation at line 176 by replacing set+e/set-e with cmd||rc=$?; add a pipeline-state.json assertion checking disposition=misconfigured on the invalid-value path to satisfy SPEC-2.

Fix tests/unit/run-watchdog-clean-exit-test.sh: replace set+e/set-e blocks at lines 80 and 131 with cmd||rc=$? to pass lint-test-errexit; strengthen the SPEC-3 assertion by (a) verifying the watchdog PID no longer exists after the runner exits (kill -0 check) and (b) explicitly sleeping past max_run_s then re-reading pipeline-state.json to assert the status is the stage-driven result, not timed_out — making the 'run inside its limit is untouched' sub-claim a direct state-file verification rather than an inference from sentinel absence.

Fix tests/integration/run-timed-out-test.sh: replace set+e/set-e blocks at lines 137, 224, 273, and 334 with cmd||rc=$? to pass lint-test-errexit; make P2's inter-dispatch assertion falsifiable by checking a specific observable (first stage result exists but second stage was never dispatched) instead of assert_pass in both conditional branches; add persist assertions on every timed-out exit path, not only P4.

Fix tests/integration/resume-after-run-timeout-test.sh: replace the set+e/set-e block at line 133 with cmd||rc=$? to pass lint-test-errexit; add an explicit timing assertion making the SPEC-4 claim non-inferential — record the resume wall-clock start time and assert the run survives past the original run's remaining window before the watchdog fires.

Fix core/pipeline/runner.sh with two implementation bugs: (1) redirect the watchdog subshell's stdout and stderr to /dev/null at arm time so the orphaned sleep child does not hold the pipe write-end open and cause $(bash ...) test invocations to hang — this fixes the three pre-existing integration test timeouts; (2) add a signal-guard (trap ':' INT TERM) before the watchdog kill/wait block inside the abort trap and restore real handlers afterwards, so a second SIGTERM arriving while wait runs does not call exit 1 from within the EXIT trap and abort _runner_dispatch_always_run — this fixes the runner-release-exit-paths-test.sh SPEC-5 regression; (3) add persist to the always_run list in the production runner code (not only in test fixtures), as R-4 requires both release and persist to run on every timed-out exit path.

Fix core/pipeline/template.sh wiring: add an end-to-end test case in tests/unit/run-limit-precedence-test.sh that invokes the runner with a fixture template file containing max_run_s, asserts the resolved limit equals the template value, so that reverting template.sh causes the test to fail and the acceptance-gate reachability check passes.

Fix tests/unit/run-open-items-test.sh: add timed_out to the O3 for-loop variable list and add an explicit assert_contains checking that run_end_words produces a message referencing the wall-clock limit, so that reverting the timed_out arm in scripts/lib/run-open-items.sh causes the test to fail and the acceptance-gate reachability check passes.

Update tests/golden/full-pipeline/event-sequence.golden, tests/golden/parity/event-sequence.golden, tests/golden/pipeline-end/timed_out-w80.colored.txt, and tests/golden/pipeline-end/timed_out-w80.layout.txt to include the new events and pipeline-end rendering emitted by the timed_out run path; regenerate all four files using the project's golden-test infrastructure so the shape-floor check passes.

Verify docs/adr/ADR-054-stage-contract.md §11 and docs/adr/ADR-025-abort-propagation.md each have Enforced by entries naming test files that exist on disk so npm run lint passes; confirm config/adr-enforcement-baseline.txt no longer lists ADR-054-stage-contract.md if §11 now has its Enforced by section — these are doc-lint correctness checks, not new content changes.

open_questions: The issue acceptance criterion says 'ADR-054 §9 amended' but §9 already exists as 'Per-stage router configuration surface' (unchanged) — the build correctly added §11; the design confirms this is a stale draft label in the issue text and no change is needed, but it is noted here for the record.

SPEC-5 requires no platform-specific variable is read, but the test checks only a finite enumerated set of known CI variables (GITHUB_ACTIONS, CI, TRAVIS, etc.); the requirement's category has no fixed boundary — confirm whether the finite-list grep approach is accepted as sufficient coverage or whether the test must be extended.
SPEC-4 NEGCTL wiring: reverting only runner.sh leaves core/state/resume.sh new, so SPEC-4 still passes — confirm whether the acceptance gate treats both files as wiring or only runner.sh.
